VERA-DEMO-01 Datasheet


Revision A. This is a fictional board and all specifications are demo data for VERA.


Supply and reset


The board operates from a regulated 3.3 V supply (3.15 V to 3.45 V). Typical idle current is 18 mA.
Maximum demo load current is 120 mA. Keep RESET low for at least 10 ms after the supply stabilizes.


Pin assignment


PB6 is I2C1 SCL and PB7 is I2C1 SDA. Both require external 4.7 kohm pull-ups to 3.3 V. PA5 drives
the status LED through a 330 ohm resistor. UART debug uses PA9 TX and PA10 RX at 115200 baud,
8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit.

I2C electrical timing


Standard mode runs at 100 kHz and fast mode at 400 kHz. The demo bus capacitance must stay
below 100 pF. The external sensor uses seven-bit address 0x48. Its ID register at 0x00 returns 0xA1
on revision A.


Clock and temperature


The internal oscillator starts at 16 MHz. The default peripheral clock is 16 MHz. The fictional operating
temperature range is 0 to 70 degrees C. Clock accuracy and temperature limits are illustrative, not
hardware guarantees.

VERA-DEMO-01 Reference Manual Excerpt


Revision A. Fictional register names and values are used for deterministic VERA document exercises.


I2C1 registers


I2C1 base address is 0x40005400. I2C1_CR1 at offset 0x00 contains PE in bit 0, TXIE in bit 1, RXIE
in bit 2 and ERRIE in bit 7. Set PE only after programming I2C1_TIMINGR. Clear PE before changing
the timing register.


I2C1_TIMINGR at offset 0x10 configures the bus clock. At a 16 MHz peripheral clock use the fictional
value 0x00303D5B for 100 kHz or 0x0010061A for 400 kHz. These values are demo facts and do not
configure a real MCU.

Transfer and error handling


I2C1_CR2 at offset 0x04 carries the seven-bit slave address in SADD bits 1 through 7, RD_WRN in
bit 10 and START in bit 13. The sensor at 0x48 is addressed with SADD 0x90. A one-byte read of ID
register 0x00 should return 0xA1.


I2C1_ISR at offset 0x18 reports TXIS bit 1, RXNE bit 2, NACKF bit 4 and BUSY bit 15. A NACKF
indicates an absent sensor, incorrect address or missing pull-ups. Clear the NACK condition before
retrying. Investigate stuck BUSY by checking the SDA and SCL levels.


Watchdog


WDG_KR at 0x40003000 accepts 0xAAAA to refresh the watchdog. The demo timeout is 1000 ms.
Keep the watchdog disabled during initial electrical checks, then enable it and refresh at least every
500 ms.

VERA-DEMO-01 Application Note: First Power-Up


Revision A. This bring-up procedure describes the fictional VERA-DEMO-01 board.


Power sequence


1. Disconnect external loads. Check resistance between 3V3 and GND before applying power.
2. Set the lab supply to 3.3 V with a 150 mA current limit.
3. Hold RESET low for 10 ms after the supply is stable, then release it.
4. Verify the UART boot line reports VERA-DEMO-01 rev=A clk=16000000.


Sensor check


Check that PB6 and PB7 idle near 3.3 V with their 4.7 kohm pull-ups. Configure I2C1_TIMINGR
before setting I2C1_CR1 PE. Read sensor ID at address 0x48 register 0x00. Expected value is 0xA1.

Troubleshooting


If the sensor NACKs, check the shifted SADD value 0x90, external pull-ups and wiring. If BUSY stays
set, inspect SDA for a low level and remove the external sensor before retrying. Capture UART output
in logs/boot-0412.log and record the measured supply voltage in docs/notes/bringup.md.


Acceptance


Acceptance requires a 3.30 V measured supply, the revision A boot line, sensor ID 0xA1 and a status
LED toggle on PA5 every 500 ms. Enable the watchdog only after these checks pass. Demo facts are
intended for retrieval tests, not for controlling physical hardware.

Bring-up notes
# Bring-up notes

The fictional VERA-DEMO-01 starts from the internal oscillator. Supply voltage measured 3.30 V.
The watchdog was disabled during first power-up. I2C SDA is PB7 and SCL is PB6.
Capture logs under logs/ and compare the reported revision before investigating a failure.
